title: Los amigos de la uni · modelos
description: The seven university friends' in-game models (src/characters/<id>.json, from `just character <id> --only fullbody model`), each loaded as the player with ?character= and framed close on the Barceloneta's sand, where the mission opens.

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, p = g.app.root.findByName('Jugador').getPosition(); document.querySelector('#hud').style.visibility = 'hidden'; g.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + 1.0, z: p.z }, 1.3); }
